prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ renderFaultTree }`.

`renderFaultTree(faults)` accepts an array of fault nodes. Each node must be a plain non-array object with nonempty string properties `code` and `note`. It may have a `children` property; when present, it must be an array obeying the same rules. Extra properties are ignored.

Return one string containing every node in depth-first pre-order, with lines joined by `\n`. Preserve the supplied sibling order. Top-level nodes are numbered `1`, `2`, and so on; child positions extend the path, such as `2.1.3`. Each line has the exact form `<path>: <note> [<code>]`. An empty root array returns the empty string. Any malformed node at any depth, including sparse array entries, must throw `TypeError`. The function must not mutate the input or any child array. Export using `module.exports` only.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
